comparabilityPolicy.tierA: Quarterly formula and filed-source status are comparable. Fiscal-quarter end dates may differ, so values are not a synchronized calendar-quarter ranking.
comparabilityPolicy.tierB: The formula is comparable but a disclosed source or measurement-window exception prevents strict ranking.
comparabilityPolicy.tierC: The measurement window differs from the main cohort. Keep for issuer context only.

limitations: The matrix fixes one public-information cutoff but uses each issuer’s latest eligible filing; fiscal-quarter end dates are not synchronized.
Company-wide filings do not isolate AI-only revenue, margin, research spending or cash flow.

Super Micro Q4 net sales, gross profit and R&D are reconstructed from its FY2026 Form 10-K less its nine-month Form 10-Q facts. Its Q4 diluted-share denominator remains a Tier B value from the SEC-filed earnings exhibit because the 10-K does not separately tag that quarter.
Cash-flow and stock-compensation observations are separated from the quarterly matrix because their reporting windows and capex definitions are not uniform.
The dataset is descriptive research. It is not a composite score, security ranking, forecast or investment recommendation.
